title: Known issues (artifacts/<product>/known-issues.json) -- human-edited, never written by an agent. A failure whose signature equals an entry's is classed known-issue by rule.

signature.description: exactly the signature triage.json shows for the failure (lib/triage.mjs signatureOf)

reference.description: the ticket or URL where the issue is tracked

module.description: limits the entry to one module; omitted = every module
